EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a strong ester carbonyl near 1752 cm⁻¹ and characteristic aliphatic C–H stretches (2888–3078 cm⁻¹) consistent with an alkyl ester (GFQ-003). Critically, the pair of bands at 1298 and 1550 cm⁻¹ matches the symmetric and antisymmetric ν(NO₂) of a nitro group (GFQ-022), and the bending near 814 cm⁻¹ further supports NO₂ (GFQ-022). The strong C–O bands around 1100 and 1234 cm⁻¹ are typical for esters. Among the candidates, only 3 (CCOC(=O)C(CO)[N+](=O)[O-]) contains both an ester and a nitro group, explaining these key features; the weak 2745 cm⁻¹ band can be a CH Fermi resonance (SPC-002).
